record.context_brief: Planar strong edge coloring with girth
record.original_question: Does there exist a constant C such that every planar graph G of girth g > 5 and maximum degree Delta satisfies chi_s(G) <= ceil(2 g (Delta - 1) / (g - 1)) + C?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 36 ([105]). There exists a constant C such that if G is any planar graph with girth g > 5 and maximum degree ∆, then χ_s(G) 6 ceil(2g(∆ − 1)/(g − 1)) + C.

There exists a constant C such that if G is any planar graph with girth g > 5 and maximum degree ∆, then χ_s(G) 6 ceil(2g(∆−1)/(g−1)) + C. This is Conjecture 36, due to Hud´ak, Luˇzar, Sot´ak, and Skrekovski.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A strong edge coloring of a simple graph $G$ is a proper edge coloring in which every two edges that are either adjacent or share a common neighbor (i.e., are at distance at most one in the line graph) receive distinct colors; equivalently, each color class is an induced matching of $G$. The strong chromatic index $\chi_s(G)$ is the minimum number of colors in a strong edge coloring of $G$. The girth of $G$ is the length of a shortest cycle (or $\infty$ if $G$ is acyclic), and $\Delta(G)$ denotes the maximum degree of $G$.

Prove or disprove: there exists an absolute constant $C$ such that for every integer $g > 5$ and every planar graph $G$ with girth at least $g$ and maximum degree $\Delta$,
$$\chi_s(G) \le \left\lceil \frac{2g(\Delta - 1)}{g - 1} \right\rceil + C.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, attributed to Hudák, Lužar, Soták, and Škrekovski, appears in published work on strong edge coloring of planar graphs with large girth. Subsequent work (e.g., Bensmail–Harutyunyan and others) has established partial results bounding the strong chromatic index of planar graphs by linear functions of $\Delta$ for specific girth values (e.g., $3\Delta+1$ for girth $\ge 6$, $3\Delta$ for girth $\ge 7$), but the unified conjecture with the stated ratio $2g(\Delta-1)/(g-1) + C$ does not appear to have been resolved in full generality. Status appears open.

status_evidence.title: Strong edge coloring of planar graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes bounds like 3Δ+6 for girth 6 and 3Δ for girth ≥ 7, partial results toward the conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results known for fixed girth values.

status_evidence.title: Strong edge-colouring of sparse planar graphs (Bensmail, Harutyunyan)
status_evidence.snippet: Improved bounds on strong chromatic index of planar graphs of large girth.
status_evidence.claim: Active research with partial bounds; the full conjecture remains.

status_evidence.title: Strong chromatic index of graphs: a short survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of strong chromatic index results and open questions.
